prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the first reference, the approved 16:9 classic QQ 2008 design, into its matching idle / NO CONVERSATION OPEN state. The second reference shows the real small-screen application layout and compact typography; use it as a functional reference only, not as pixel art to enlarge. The third reference is the approved H1 QQ penguin artwork; use that recognizable black penguin, red scarf, white belly, and yellow beak/feet as the mascot reference, with no blue app-icon tile around the mascot.

Deliver ONE finished 16:9 landscape interface design, ideally 1600x900, edge-to-edge UI, flat straight-on. No device mockup, no presentation border, no split comparison, no annotations. Preserve the approved QQ2008 sky-blue glass chrome, cloud wisps, faint globe/map and curved waves, white inset panels, fine beveled blue borders, square avatars, and small colorful 2008-style skeuomorphic icons. Keep it much closer to QQ2008 than a modern messenger. No modern rounded-card dashboard, smartphone chat bubbles, purple, dark theme, giant typography or marketing graphics. Conceptually this fits the H1 480x272 screen; depict labels about 25% smaller than the oversized text in reference 1, corresponding to readable native 12px bitmap UI text enlarged for review.

Keep the shared slim top title bar with a small penguin and 'QQ 2008', refresh icon and close control. Keep a narrow left roster around 31-32% width and a broad right area around 68-69%. Left roster remains usable and populated: compact own-account cloud-blue header, square avatar and nickname '小Q' plus small green status badge; inset search field labeled '搜索'; small tabs '好友', '群', '最近'. Show the expanded group '我的好友（3/16）' with square avatars and rows '星空', '小鱼', '阿杰', plus '同学（2/8）' and '木木'. Neutral white contact rows: no yellow selected contact and no active conversation indication. A fine classic scrollbar. A small glossy bottom-left footer with penguin menu, search, recent clock, refresh icons. These are short necessary labels only.

REDESIGN THE RIGHT AREA specifically for the idle state: there is no recipient or active conversation. Remove the recipient avatar/name header, conversation toolbar, transcript, message input field, send button and any disabled chat controls. Instead make ONE calm uninterrupted welcome/idle canvas filling the right pane, with a nearly white / very pale ice-blue field and subtle classic blue-glass rim. The upper edge can have a restrained cloud/wave flourish matching the window chrome, and the lower corners a delicate pale blue translucent wave/globe watermark. Keep most of the pane airy and uncluttered. Center a tasteful medium-size friendly classic QQ penguin mascot, approximately 25-30% of the entire window height, softly shaded in the same early-2000s QQ visual language, resting on a faint oval shadow / very pale cloud puff. Cute and recognizable but not a large 3D toy, no blue rounded-square app-icon background, no speech bubbles with text. A few tiny low-contrast floating pale-blue chat/sparkle motifs may surround it, sparse enough to be practical to rasterize on the H1. The composition should feel like the nostalgic QQ application's quiet start screen, not an advertisement or an error/empty-results page.

No explanatory sentence or caption in the right pane. No 'select a friend', no keyboard instructions, no onboarding checklist, no giant 'welcome', no network/USB/ESP/native/debug details, no quotes, no slogans, no unread counts invented on the right. Communicate that no chat is open through the clear idle illustration and the absence of chat controls. Preserve the overall style and left-side proportions of the approved design. The result should look ready to implement as the companion state of the existing QQ2008 interface.
